scripts.dev: bun run --filter @sky/shared build && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web "bun run --filter @sky/shared dev" "bun run --filter @sky/server dev" "bun run --filter @sky/web dev"
scripts.build: bun run --filter @sky/shared build && bun run --filter @sky/server build && bun run --filter @sky/web build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @sky/shared build && bun run --filter '@sky/*' typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --filter @sky/shared build && tsx --test packages/shared/src/*.test.ts apps/server/src/*.test.ts apps/web/src/game/*.test.ts apps/web/src/generation/*.test.ts apps/web/src/voice/*.test.ts apps/web/src/race-events/*.test.ts
scripts.dev:live: bun run --filter @sky/shared build && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web "bun run --filter @sky/shared dev" "bun run --filter @sky/server dev:live" "bun run --filter @sky/web dev"
scripts.build:deploy: bun run build:deploy:server && bun run build:deploy:web
scripts.build:deploy:server: bun run --filter @sky/shared build && bun run --filter @sky/server build
scripts.build:deploy:web: bun run --filter @sky/shared build && bun run --filter @sky/web build
